    Tree configurations from arrows #

    A configuration (Tab.Conf) of a finite poset whose cover paths are unique is determined by rays on the cover arrows, provided every path product is nonzero: ρ a b is the product along the unique path (Conf.ofArrows). This is how the paper presents its trees ("every path survives").
